title: Refactor plan kinds need per-kind JSON schemas and examples
wanted_capability: A single-kind describe API returning exact JSON schema, required and optional field types, operator opt-out flags, semantic status, preflight commands, example invocations, and expected response shape for one refactor kind.
fallback_used: Used the broad plan-kind catalog and runbook prose, which gives required field names but not a precise per-kind invocation schema.
notes: The current broad bbox_refactor_plan schema is too large and union-shaped for reliable isolate composition.
resolution_note: Partially met by bbox_refactor_plan_kinds (crates/bbox-refactor/src/lib.rs:1290 via add_plan_kind_group :1552), which already returns per-kind: language, safety_class, backend, item_kinds, required_fields, optional_fields, suggested_preflight (ordered+default_first+notes), semantic_status_expected/meaning, when_to_use, notes. Remaining asks (typed JSON schema, opt-out flags, example invocations, response shape) are deliberately not pursued: the v1 bbox_refactor_* catalog is CLOSED and on the kill list (decision af3c4783 "Refactor tooling is harness-native; daemon refactor surfaces retire with no bridge" + b8dc263d; bbox-refactor/AGENTS.md). New capability lands as bro-harness cell bindings (code.*/edits.*/java.*/analysis.*), not a richer v1 describe API. Building the requested endpoint would invest in the retiring path.
